read_xy.description: Read X and Y sampled together; returns two comma-separated values in volts.

input_overload_detected.description: Read and clear LIA status bit 0 (INPUT/RESRV): 1 when an input or amplifier overload was detected since the bit was last read or cleared.

filter_overload_detected.description: Read and clear LIA status bit 1 (FILTR): 1 when a time constant filter overload was detected since the bit was last read or cleared.

output_overload_detected.description: Read and clear LIA status bit 2 (OUTPT): 1 when an output overload was detected since the bit was last read or cleared.

reference_unlock_detected.description: Read and clear LIA status bit 3 (UNLK): 1 when a reference unlock was detected since the bit was last read or cleared.

conditions.description: No reference unlock since the previous observation
conditions.note: LIA status bits stay set until read; reading the bit clears it, so the next observation shows whether the condition has returned.

conditions.description: No input or amplifier overload since the previous observation
conditions.note: An overload is removed by a lower sensitivity or a higher dynamic reserve; the experiment decides which. LIA status bits stay set until read; reading the bit clears it, so the next observation shows whether the condition has returned.

conditions.description: No time constant filter overload since the previous observation
conditions.note: LIA status bits stay set until read; reading the bit clears it, so the next observation shows whether the condition has returned.

conditions.description: No output overload since the previous observation
conditions.note: LIA status bits stay set until read; reading the bit clears it, so the next observation shows whether the condition has returned.
